info.name: Blind Insight REST accounts blindllm-queries API

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of results to return per page.

params.name: offset
params.description: The initial index from which to return the results.

items.docs:
API for BlindLLM analyst queries.

list:     Returns prior queries scoped to the user's organizations.
retrieve: One query by id.
create:   Run an analyst query against the org's encrypted data via
          the configured Cloud Proxy. Falls back to deterministic mock
          tool handlers when the org has no `blindllm` proxy credentials.
